subject: invention/dog-sledge
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset: invention card sketch in a historical atlas.
One landscape 3:2 page from an explorers field sketchbook. Visible loose graphite construction lines, quick sepia ink and parallel hatching, restrained uneven watercolour washes in ochre, grey-green and faded blue. Detail concentrated on the principal object or action; outer edges dissolve irregularly into warm cream paper with subtle foxing. An observed working sketch, not a polished painting, digital render, photograph, infographic or collage. A single coherent principal scene, optionally one small unlabelled detail study. No frame, binding, captions, labels, signature, watermark or readable writing. Any marks on historic artifacts remain small and nonverbal. People, materials and tools appropriate to the place and date.
Subject: Wide low Arctic shore scene about1100CE: Thule travellers loading a light wooden sled with dog team in foreground, an open skin-covered umiak resting on supports on shore behind. Sea ice and low tundra, practical skin clothing, no metal runners or modern kayak gear.
